title: Maidane Karbala Mein
body:
maidane karbala mein wo akbar teri azan
sunkar hussain rodiye mehve fughan thi maa
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sehr payame ajal mein dhali hui
maghmoom tere sehre ki ek ek kali hui
zainab tamaam shab rahi sajdon ke darmiyan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo azan thi jisme tha lehja rasool ka
isme dikhayi deta tha sajda batool ka
isme namaziyon ka musalla tha aasman
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
haa is ada ne arsh ka suraj jaga diya
itne dilon mein shaukhe shahadat badha diya
sunkar habeeb ibne mazahir hue jawan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
thi ek azan sehar ki to ek asr ki azan
tha kitna farkh dono azano ke darmiyan
akbar azane asr talak kha chuke sina
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan teri shaadi ka poora na ho saka
kanga bandha na mehndi lagi wa musibata
behno ke dil udaas hai nauha kuna hai maa
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
bali sakina nayg mein ab kya talab kare
karbobala larazti hai zainab ke bain se
kha kar sina rawana hue tum suye jina
maidane karbala mein....
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban aagayi qaime sulag uthe
bache tamaam khaakh pe pyaase hi sogaye
akbar phuphi ke shaano mein bandti hai reesma
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar talay hussain ne tumko kiya tha yaad
maa zinda laash hogayi akbar tumhare baad
aise gaye ho ghar se ke milta nahi nishan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle mustufa thay dilon ka kharaar thay
tum to zaeef baap ka daaro madaar thay
hai tere baad gulshane shabbir mein khiza
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir jawani-e-ali akbar ka waasta
nauhe mein apne jis ghadi rehaan ne diya
sar par ridaye zehra hui misle sayeban
maidane karbala mein…
author: Rehaan Azmi
